forces.title: AI and Technology Integration Driving Efficiency and Cost Savings
forces.description: The adoption of AI and advanced technology in asset-heavy industries, such as airlines, for maintenance processes leads to significant operational efficiencies, including reduced downtime and inventory costs. This proven approach, yielding substantial P&L savings, creates a strong tailwind for IT Services & Consulting firms offering AI implementation, systems integration, and managed services for digital transformation projects across various sectors aiming for similar benefits.
forces.source_title: Maintenance meets AI: A proven approach for asset-heavy industries

forces.title: Uneven AI Impact Reshaping Consultancy Service Demand
forces.description: The emergence of AI technology is creating a structural shift for consultancy firms in Norway. While it opens new business opportunities in AI consultancy and solution implementation, it simultaneously reduces demand for certain traditional services as clients become more self-reliant through AI adoption. This dual effect necessitates that IT Services & Consulting firms strategically adapt their offerings, focusing on high-value AI-centric services to navigate the evolving market landscape and remain competitive.
forces.source_title: Regional Network report 3/2026: Minor changes in growth prospects

forces.title: Data Center Buildout Fuels Services and Technology Investment
forces.description: Increased data center construction and related technology investments are identified as a significant growth driver in Norway. This trend is pulling up investment among service contacts in 2026 and is expected to accelerate growth into 2027. For IT Services & Consulting, this represents a strong tailwind, driving demand for infrastructure planning, deployment, managed services, and specialized solutions required to support the expanding data center ecosystem and associated computational needs.
forces.source_title: Regional Network report 3/2026: Minor changes in growth prospects

forces.title: Accelerated Cross-Sector Technology Investment
forces.description: Technology investment is pushing up overall investment across various sectors in Norway, contributing to accelerated growth. This broad-based increase in technology adoption indicates a robust tailwind for the IT Services & Consulting sector. Companies across industries are allocating more capital to technology, creating sustained demand for IT consulting, system integration, software development, and managed services as they seek to modernize operations, enhance capabilities, and drive productivity improvements.
forces.source_title: Regional Network report 3/2026: Minor changes in growth prospects

forces.title: Emergence of 'AI Software & Services' as High-Growth Arena
forces.description: The identification of 'AI software & services' as a rapidly growing 'arena' signifies a major structural change in the economy. This arena exhibits exceptional growth and competitive dynamism, generating significant demand shocks across value chains, including for enabling services. This represents a powerful upside driver for IT Services & Consulting, as firms that effectively allocate capital and resources to AI-centric offerings will capture substantial new value, reshaping traditional industry boundaries and competitive advantages.
forces.source_title: Strategy in the age of arenas

forces.title: AI Drives Deep Workflow Integration and Tailored Automation
forces.description: AI is fundamentally transforming enterprise automation, shifting from standardized software to solutions deeply embedded in complex workflows. European companies, accustomed to heterogeneous markets and regulatory rigor, are well-positioned to build adaptable, tailored software that integrates directly into systems of record. This structural change demands specialized IT consulting and integration services to architect and implement compliance-native AI products, creating valuable enterprise moats and higher switching costs for clients, driving demand for advanced IT services.
forces.source_title: Europe’s new AI edge? The emerging application layer opportunity

forces.title: AI Adoption in Food & Drink Sector for Productivity Gains
forces.description: The Irish Food and Drink sector's increasing adoption of AI, automation, and digitalization to improve productivity, quality control, predictive maintenance, production planning, and supply chain management represents a strong tailwind for IT Services & Consulting. This strategic investment, supported by public and private initiatives, creates significant demand for IT service providers who can deliver and implement these advanced solutions, fostering innovation and competitiveness within client industries and generating new revenue streams for the sector.
forces.source_title: Bank of Ireland Food and Drink Sector H1 2026 Insights and H2 2026 Outlook August 2026

viewpoints.title: AI and technology integration drives significant savings in asset-heavy industries
viewpoints.description: McKinsey highlights that the introduction of AI and technology into maintenance processes for an airline significantly reduced aircraft on ground (AOG) time by 14 percent and lowered inventory by 12 percent. This collectively unlocked savings equivalent to 10 percent of maintenance profit and loss. The success was due to a phased approach, prioritizing processes for significant impact and less complex change management. This demonstrates a strong positive outlook for IT services firms specializing in AI/technology implementation and consulting.
viewpoints.source_title: Maintenance meets AI: A proven approach for asset-heavy industries

viewpoints.title: AI's impact on Norwegian consultancy firms is mixed, creating new but also reducing existing demand
viewpoints.description: Norges Bank's Regional Network contacts in Norway report that artificial intelligence is affecting consultancy firms unevenly. For some, AI technology presents new business opportunities through AI consultancy and solution implementation services. However, for others, AI reduces demand for certain services as customers become increasingly self-reliant. This indicates a neutral to cautious positive outlook, emphasizing the need for consultancy firms to adapt their service offerings to leverage AI capabilities and offset potential disintermediation.
viewpoints.source_title: Regional Network report 3/2026: Minor changes in growth prospects

viewpoints.title: AI software and services identified as a high-growth 'arena' reshaping value creation
viewpoints.description: McKinsey Global Institute (MGI) identifies 'AI software & services' as one of the new industry archetypes, or 'arenas,' that have exhibited exceptional growth and competitive dynamism. These arenas grow and evolve faster, draw in more new entrants, and concentrate value in fewer players. MGI suggests that leaders need to understand these dynamics, as arenas reshape value creation through competition, demand shocks, and supply shifts. This signals a highly positive outlook for the IT Services & Consulting sector, particularly in AI-related offerings.
viewpoints.source_title: Strategy in the age of arenas

viewpoints.title: Irish Food and Drink sector's AI adoption signals demand for IT services
viewpoints.description: Bank of Ireland notes that AI adoption in the Irish Food and Drink sector is progressing from experimentation to practical implementation. This adoption supports crucial areas like quality control, predictive maintenance, production planning, and supply chain management. Public and private sector initiatives are actively helping businesses explore and deploy AI solutions. This trend suggests a positive outlook for IT Services & Consulting providers, as it indicates a growing demand for their expertise in implementing and managing AI, automation, and digitalization solutions within client industries.
viewpoints.source_title: Bank of Ireland Food and Drink Sector H1 2026 Insights and H2 2026 Outlook August 2026

viewpoints.title: AI expected to fundamentally transform software and services industries' future growth
viewpoints.description: Matthew Brockman, Chief Investment Officer and Chair of Hg’s Investment Committee, emphasizes AI as a critical pillar for future growth. He views AI technology as instrumental in transforming both the software and services industries. This perspective signals a highly positive and transformative outlook for the IT Services & Consulting sector. The increasing integration of AI is expected to redefine operational models and value propositions, making AI-driven solutions and consulting services central to industry evolution and competitive advantage.
viewpoints.source_title: Europe’s new AI edge? The emerging application layer opportunity

viewpoints.title: Europe's AI edge in deep workflow integration drives business process transformation
viewpoints.description: McKinsey suggests Europe has an emerging AI edge in transforming complex business processes through deep workflow integration, particularly in regulated environments. The AI era rewards tailored automation over standardized software, embedding solutions directly into enterprise systems for operational context and action. European companies are well-positioned for this due to experience with heterogeneous markets and compliance-native architecture. This implies a positive outlook for IT Services & Consulting firms capable of delivering bespoke AI-driven transformation, offering higher switching costs and faster procurement in regulated sectors.
viewpoints.source_title: Europe’s new AI edge? The emerging application layer opportunity

demand_drivers.description: AI drives demand for IT consulting and implementation to transform complex business processes and achieve deep workflow integration, moving beyond standardized software solutions for enhanced efficiency and value creation.

Significant capital expenditure in data center buildouts and AI compute creates substantial demand for enabling IT services and infrastructure solutions, including design, implementation, and managed services.
Industries are increasing investment in automation, digitalization, and AI to improve productivity, quality control, predictive maintenance, and supply chain management, necessitating IT services.

new_opportunities.description: AI creates new business opportunities for IT consultancy and solution implementation services, particularly in vertical applications requiring specialized expertise for deployment and integration.

European companies are well-positioned to offer bespoke IT solutions for complex and heavily regulated environments, providing deep workflow integration and tailored automation that generates high value.

market_sizing.methodology: Analysis of sector reports highlighting key demand drivers and new opportunities for IT Services & Consulting, including AI adoption, technology integration, data center buildout, and enterprise digital transformation initiatives across various industries. No explicit market size figures were provided for the IT Services & Consulting sector itself.
market_sizing.source_firm: McKinsey, Norges Bank, Bank of Ireland
